name: boom
description: BoomTube — declarative dev-machine setup (executable: boom). Converge your machine from a declarative boomfile.toml — dotfiles, packages, and tools (sync/verify) with drift detection.

scripts.build:all: for t in bun-darwin-arm64 bun-darwin-x64 bun-linux-x64 bun-linux-arm64; do bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=$t --outfile ${BOOM_OUT:-build}/boom-$t || exit 1; done
